_doc: Render massing for K in Kortrijk (shopping centre, Robbrecht en Daem 2010), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (OSM way 1014884611 centroid), u along 'axis_deg' (the glass roof's long axis on the 2024 orthophoto, degrees CCW from grid east). Heights from DHMV II: flat roofs 16.5-17.2 m (north wing 12-15 m), glass roof top 25 m. Facades (Street View screenshots from Tom, look-up only, AGENTS.md rule 1): light grey concrete, tall framed shop windows, a recessed top storey clad in vertical timber slats; the south entrance (Koeiekop, the notch at u -46..-39 in the GRB footprint) is a glass atrium under a big angled canopy with a hole, with a large red 'K' logo left of it (canopy and logo are a 2D edit, edit_k.ts). Shape from the Digitaal Vlaanderen orthophotos (summer 2024, winter 2025; open data) and Commons photos (refs/): a block with a flat dark roof and a large glass HIP roof (112 x 28 m, light blue-grey, flat light strip on top) over the inner square, not a barrel. The hip is a gable along u plus a pyramid at each end. Sint-Janstoren (GRB 363006, 46 m in OSM, DSM 43.5 m): white stepped residential tower on a dark grey plinth, roof garden; its massing is in ../sint-janstoren/massing.json (own anchor). GRB 944613 (a 'verdieping' strip under the west end of the glass, 25.4 m from 3D GRB) is replaced too: it is the glass roof, not a building. GRB 4600487 (the south-west wing, 3D GRB 20.9 m, rendered as a big slate gable) is the same flat dark roof on the orthophoto (DSM 16.5 m) and is replaced by the block too. Glass rect checked against the orthophoto overlay.

recessed top storey: timber slats and big windows (GRB footprint shrunk 3.5 m)
glass atrium wall at the back of the south entrance passage
